metadata.clan_summary:
[bold #D75FFF]◆ EPIC sase-uk[/bold #D75FFF]
[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]A link-traversing SASE pager[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]SASE has one reading surface. `sase bead show`, the Agents-tab `v` [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]keymap, `sase artifact read`, and the new `sase pager` command all [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]render the same `PagerDocument` through the same Textual app; every[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]artifact ref, file path, and URL in that document carries a [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]pre-painted key; one keypress follows it into another pager [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]document instead of dead-ending in `less`; `ctrl+n`/`ctrl+p` puts [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]the next entity's header at row 0; and a visible breadcrumb trail [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]walks back with `backspace`.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim] Counts: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]10[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] phases[dim][/dim] · [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]9[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] waves[/dim]
[dim]   Path: [#87AFFF][/dim]plan:202608/[bold #87AFFF][/#87AFFF]link_traversing_pager.md[/bold #87AFFF]
[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]The allocator and the scanner[/bold #D7AFFF]                                 [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]primitives[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]primitives: create the beta flag, extend `jump_hints` with prefix-free [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]variable-width label allocation over a reserved-key alphabet, and add [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]the one `link_scan` module that finds typed refs, URLs, paths, and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]origin-scoped bare tokens in plain text.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]A document of sections, not a string[/bold #D7AFFF]                          [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]document[dim] · [dim][/dim]after primitives[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]document: add `PagerDocument`/`PagerSection`/`PagerOrigin`, ingest ANSI [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]bodies through `Text.from_ansi`, accept caller-attached typed targets [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]bound to spans, and build the two adapters that turn a bead show batch [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]and a path list into sections.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  3 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]The reading surface[/bold #D7AFFF]                                           [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]viewer[dim] · [dim][/dim]after document[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]viewer: build the `SasePager` Textual app shell — the sticky chrome [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]band, section rules, scrolling, `ctrl+n`/`ctrl+p` scroll-to-header, the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]availability-driven footer legend, and the re-hosted [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]`VimSearchController` — wired to no caller yet.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  4 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Keys painted ahead of time[/bold #D7AFFF]                                    [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]labels[dim] · [dim][/dim]after viewer[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]labels: paint one stable key capsule before every scanned link, match [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]keypresses through `normalize_jump_key` and `match_jump_hint`, give [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]pending prefixes visible feedback, and ship the window-scoped fallback [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]dormant.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  5 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]A press that always lands[/bold #D7AFFF]                                     [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]follow[dim] · [dim][/dim]after labels[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]follow: define the `resolve_ref` interface with its CLI-backed [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]implementation, open resolved targets as new pager documents rather than[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]escaping to a viewer, remember and dim dead ends, delegate media to [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]`graphics`, and add the one-shot `y`/`E` prefixes.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  6 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Breadcrumbs you can see and walk back[/bold #D7AFFF]                         [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]trail[dim] · [dim][/dim]after follow[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]trail: add the bounded pager-owned trail whose entries restore the view [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]rather than just the document, render it as a kind-glyph breadcrumb [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]strip that is absent at depth zero, and bind [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]`backspace`/`ctrl+o`/`ctrl+i` with the exhausted-trail exit rule.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  7 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]The `sase pager` command[/bold #D7AFFF]                                      [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]cli[dim] · [dim][/dim]after trail[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]cli: add the `sase pager` top-level command over refs, paths, and stdin;[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]route `page_or_print` in-process when the resolved pager is SASE's own [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]so `sase bead show` gets the new surface; and document it.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  8 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]`v` opens the pager[/bold #D7AFFF]                                           [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]ace[dim] · [dim][/dim]after trail[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]ace: route the Agents-tab `v` keymap to `SasePager` under `suspend()`, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]carrying the selected files as sections and the typed commit and report [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]specs as attached targets, within the measured open-to-first-paint [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]budget.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  9 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]One ref, one destination, one glyph[/bold #D7AFFF]                           [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]parity[dim] · [dim][/dim]after cli, ace[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]parity: assert with one shared test that the pager and the `sase-ug` [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]link rail resolve the same ref to the same target, glyph, accent, and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]dangling vocabulary, and swap the resolver onto the live `LinkIndex` [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]when that epic has landed it.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  10 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Four pagers become one[/bold #D7AFFF]                                       [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]land[dim] · [dim][/dim]after parity[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]land: delete `_print_or_page`, `_view_files_with_pager`, and the `less` [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]back end of `page_or_print`, point the text mode of the artifact viewer [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]at the pager, remove the flag, and close the flag bead — as a net [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]deletion.[/#D7D7AF]

commits.subject: feat(pager): align link resolution with rail index
feat(ace): route the Agents-tab v keymap to SasePager under suspend()
feat(pager): add prefix-free jump-hint allocator and link scanner
